clean-studio.desc_ar: خلفية بيضاء ناعمة وإضاءة أمامية — للمتاجر والكتالوج
clean-studio.signature: seamless white-to-light-grey gradient backdrop, soft frontal key light, minimal contact shadow

dramatic.desc_ar: ظلال عميقة وإضاءة حافة — للعطور والإلكترونيات
dramatic.signature: single hard rim light, deep shadows, dark moody backdrop, controlled specular highlights

lifestyle.desc_ar: المنتج في مكان حقيقي بضوء نافذة طبيعي
lifestyle.signature: product in a real environment, natural window daylight, shallow depth of field, ambient props

saudi-heritage.desc_ar: خشب أو حجر منقوش ولمسات عود وقهوة
saudi-heritage.signature: warm earth tones, aged wood or carved stone surface, oud and Arabic coffee accents, soft amber light

ramadan.signature: warm lanterns, dates and coffee props, soft amber light, subtle Islamic geometric motifs

luxury.signature: polished marble or velvet surface, low warm key light, controlled reflections, jewel-tone backdrop

vibrant.desc_ar: خلفية بلون واحد قوي وتكوين حديث
vibrant.signature: saturated solid-colour backdrop, bold colour blocking, flat modern composition

floating.desc_ar: المنتج معلّق في الهواء على خلفية نظيفة
floating.signature: product suspended mid-air, subtle motion blur on accents, clean studio backdrop

prompt_template:
[SUBJECT] Hero shot of the referenced product exactly as shown — same shape, colours, materials and label; label text preserved sharp and unwarped.
[COMPOSITION] {{angle}}, {{framing}}, product occupies 55–70% of the frame, rule-of-thirds placement.
{{#if scene}}[SCENE] {{scene}}.{{/if}}
[LIGHTING] {{preset.signature}}.
[LENS] 85mm, f/5.6, tack-sharp focus on the label, gentle background falloff.
[PALETTE] product colours dominant; {{brand_colors|neutral complementary tones}}.
{{#if text}}[TYPOGRAPHY] Integrated typography in the scene reads «{{text}}» in a bold modern Arabic typeface, correctly shaped connected letters, high contrast, placed naturally within the composition.{{/if}}
[QUALITY] tack-sharp, hyper-detailed, photorealistic, commercial-grade product photography.
[AVOID] warped or mirrored letters, extra fingers, duplicated product, watermark, flat empty colour bands, muddy background.
negative: blurry, low resolution, distorted label, mirrored text, pseudo-Arabic glyphs, extra products
